title: CBG plant at Brahmapuram to reach full capacity of 150 tonnes by third week of August, says BPCL-KR
description: BPCL-KR says the plant is undergoing the normal stabilisation period before scaling up to its installed capacity; Kochi Corporation has blamed the plant’s inability to process the promised volume and says it is preparing to petition the Chief Minister. BPCL-KR attributes the delay to operational and waste quality issues
